proposed_ledger_entry: Item 327 makes two genuinely transverse uses of Item 323's exact all-depth transducer. First, it strengthens Item 316's fixed-precision construction uniformly: for every n>=6 and every moving s with 2^s<=2n-3, an explicit two-top-digit canonical word lies in the intermediate window, has the positive actual-target sign and 0<|E|<c, carries the complete universal all-depth transducer, and satisfies U congruent to a modulo 2^s while U is not equal to a. Thus logarithmically growing dyadic precision is an information-class no-go; its entire raw mass is O(log n)=o(n), so it also fails capacity admission. Second, with L_j=R H_j-b N_j and H_m=1,L_m=R, every divisor D of b sees L_j congruent to R H_j. Under an actual target R is a unit, so every homogeneous polynomial of arbitrary degree and at arbitrarily many depths vanishes on L modulo D iff it vanishes on the fixed suffix vector H. General polynomials reduce to the one scalar R, which on the actual target is the already-known signed square ray R congruent to epsilon a^2. Hence the all-depth residual tower supplies no new projective nonlinear codimension. Divided quotients, mod b^2, integer-size invariants, complement redigitization, and dyadic precision beyond 2n-3 remain open. Booking is zero.
